maria: Heads-up — we're rolling out changes to audit event coverage and schema for RBAC and KMS-related actions. Need customer‑facing guidance, changelog text, and a validation script. @kevin @sara can you weigh in?

kevin: Quick q — for KMS events, do we want to send raw key ids? customers ask about PII and policy. Also need canonical samples for key create/rotate/delete.

maria: We'll avoid raw key material. Proposed sample below (schema_version -> "3"):
```
{
  "schema_version": "3",
  "event_type": "kms.key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2026-04-01T18:12:34Z",
  "principal": "alice@example.com",
  "action": "rotate",
  "resource": {
    "type": "kms_key",
    "id": "sha256:3f5d...",
    "fingerprint": "pub-fp:9a7b..."
  },
  "rbac": {
    "change": "role_update",
    "before": "reader",
    "after": "admin"
  },
  "request_id": "req_abc123",
  "metadata": { "region": "us-west-2" }
}
```

sara: Would add a top-level `schema_version` and `compatibility`: "If you rely on fields `id` or `fingerprint`, treat them as opaque. We will emit v2 for 2 weeks if feature-flagged." Also: include `event_severity` for alerts.

jordan: Rollout plan suggestion — emit both v2 and v3 events behind a feature flag for 14 days, then flip and log a deprecation header `x-audit-schema-deprecated: v2`. We'll publish a migration checklist and a small validation script customers can run.

kevin: I can prototype a validator in the SDK. Example snippet for quick check:
```
def validate_audit(evt):
    assert evt.get("schema_version") in ("2","3")
    assert evt.get("event_type")
    assert "resource" in evt and "id" in evt["resource"]
```

maria: Perfect. Action items: (1) @sara draft customer-facing doc + changelog blurb; (2) @kevin add validator to SDK + small CLI; (3) @jordan own rollout feature flag and log header; (4) I'll loop in legal + PS for retention/PII wording. We'll add notes to release notes and send partner comms. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345 – tests/audit_event_validation.py -> 12 passed. CI: audit-schema tests ok.

kevin: I'll attach the draft validator and sample events to the PR later today.

maria: Thanks all — aiming to ship docs and staged rollout on 2026-04-08. Ping me if blockers arise.
